name: wedding-rsvp
description: Wedding RSVP and wedding website for Andrew & Madeline: a public guest site with token-gated RSVP, and a separate admin app, sharing one SQLite database.

scripts.build: npm run build -w app && npm run build -w admin
scripts.check: npm run check -w app && npm run check -w admin
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w app && npm run test:e2e -w admin
